notes:
Settings descriptions and helper text are smaller and use secondary Material text colour. The default Settings scrollbar is hidden; swipe and remote scrolling remain.
Closing PiP stops playback outside the app. Returning reopens the channel once after foreground resume and focus, including compatibility playback and custom streams. Explicit Pause, Stop, sleep expiry, focus loss and errors prevent unwanted recovery. Removed channels and changed playlists are discarded; EPG loading does not delay channel recovery. Expanding visible PiP keeps playing.
The optional fullscreen clock now uses tabular numerals, a compact Material surface and larger edge insets. It remains passive and hides during controls, numeric tuning and PiP.
Native libraries, decoder profiles, stream buffers and EPG sources are unchanged.
